_comment: Owned by the audio task (src/client/audio/**, tools/gen-audio.ts, public/audio/**). All prompts/lines are original wording — no Games Workshop text. Run `npx tsx tools/gen-audio.ts` to (re)generate missing files into public/audio/<id>.mp3.
